response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat HAVING AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT r.insurstat, AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS above_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(r.avg_ratio - a.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY r.insurstat
